# A higher-order function run(f) calls its funcvar parameter f().
# One call site passes a sync func; another passes an async native.
# g3 conservative rule: any async candidate in pts(f-param) → await f().
# The run function becomes async and each call site awaits it.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# run is async because its param slot may receive an async candidate.
grep 'async function run' out/index.html

# The funcvar param call inside run's body is awaited (g3 fallback).
grep 'await f()' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import api "js:./api"

func syncHello() string {
    return "sync"
}

func run(f func() string) {
    f()
}

component main {
    button(text="RunSync", @click { run(syncHello) })
    button(text="RunAsync", @click { run(api.fetchHello) })
    text(value="hi")
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(): Promise<string> { return "hi"; }
